title: Boolean function associated to an $\mathbb{F}_2$ hypothesis
statement: For a nonnegative integer $r$, let $h$ be a function from the $r$-dimensional cube over $\mathbb{F}_2$ to $\mathbb{F}_2$. The associated Boolean function on the sign cube is obtained by converting each sign input to its $\mathbb{F}_2$ cube point, evaluating $h$, and converting the output to a sign.
